name: Threshbarrage
description: Swing the iron-banded head down on the crown of a helm with the full weight of the body behind it.

name: Rebound Onslaught
description: Hammer the head onto a plated shoulder to numb the arm beneath rather than pierce the metal.

name: Rumble Thresh
description: Swing flat at the breastplate so the blow carries through the metal into the ribs below.

name: Swivelplating
description: Take an axe blow on the iron-shod haft held crosswise and let the chain slacken to soak up the jar.

name: Hingecap Pounce
description: Advance in short heavy steps timed to the swing so the weight of armor never costs the stance.

name: Gimbalbarrage
description: Strike the side of the helm to ring the skull inside and leave the opponent dazed.

name: Rumbleswivel
description: Bring the head down on a gauntleted hand pressed to a haft to pinch the fingers inside the metal.

name: Wheelplating
description: Hook a spike of the head under a breastplate edge and haul to unbalance the wearer.

name: Rumble Headball
description: Charge the head with qi so its spikes bite through a plate joint on a single overhead fall.

name: Grinding Sanguine Handstaff
description: Pour qi into a wide swing that spreads its force across the whole breastplate and cracks it.

name: Grinding Wheel
description: Draw a thread of qi down the chain so the head flies true on a long throw.

name: Gimbalplating
description: Hold the haft in a stance steadied by the body's qi field against a heavy blow.

name: Hastening Spikehead
description: Let a pulse of qi quicken a short step so the swing keeps pace with the body.

name: Chainlink Linctus
description: Spread the qi field along the chain to feel what the head touches before sight can tell.

name: Skinning Lashout
description: Feed the qi field into a circling head so it gains weight with every full turn.

name: Irongimbal
description: Send a pulse of qi along the whole chain so the head cracks out faster than the wrist moves.

name: Steadfast Flailhead
description: Pack qi into the haft's length and parry a blade so it glances off with no jar to the arm.

name: Blaze Looping
description: Hold the swing at its peak while qi gathers in the head then release it as one heavy fall.

name: Swivel Onslaught
description: Bind the head to the qi field after a strike so one tug returns it already moving for a second blow.

name: Hoarfrost Linkband
description: Throw a loop of chain over a sword blade and draw back to take it off its line.

name: Gyveflail
description: Snag a belt or shoulder strap with a spike of the head and turn the haft to tie the opponent close.

name: Toxin Thresh
description: Twist the haft a half turn to tighten the chain on a snared weapon and loosen the foe's hold.

name: Chime Chainring
description: Shake a tangled chain loose while the haft keeps a pursuing blade at bay.

name: Silt Swingarm
description: Step across the line of a snared blade to leave the opponent bound behind his own weapon.

name: Swivel Linctus
description: Gauge a bound weapon's resistance through the chain to judge when the opponent will pull.

name: Fastening Swingthru
description: Roll the chain along a staff to lock it against the haft and wrench the staff from the hands.

name: Flailgreave
description: Coil the chain about an ankle as the foe steps and pull to put him on the ground.

name: Gyve Rebound
description: Wind the chain about both of the opponent's forearms and cinch them together at the chest.

name: Mayhem Wheel
description: Heave on a wrapped weapon with the whole body's weight to rip it clean out of the opponent's hands.

name: Dominating Flailhead
description: Spiral the chain up an opponent's limbs in one flowing motion that leaves him bound arm to hip.

name: Mightflail
description: Start the head circling and keep it circling without a break through attack and defense alike.

name: Handstaff Cloak
description: Let the circling head sweep any blow aside while the qi field cushions the contact.

name: Hastening Linkband
description: Move on a slow circle around the opponent with the feet matched to the head's orbit.

name: Remnant Swingarm
description: Feel the orbit's tempo in the chain and notice any beat where it wavers.

name: Ironflail
description: Release the head from its orbit along the tangent at the exact moment it lines up with the target.

name: Equipoise Chainlink
description: Roll the orbit along the arm and across the back to turn aside a thrust from any side.

name: Wheelthrash
description: Widen the orbit into a ring of iron that strikes everything near it as it spins.

name: Sanguine Spikehead
description: Link orbit to orbit so the blows never pause and the qi field pays the cost of every turn.

name: Scorching Swingthru
description: Swing one head high and one low at the same instant from a grip on two hafts.

name: Hardened Chainring
description: Stand wide in the basin stance with both haft arms crossed before the chest.

name: Granite Lashout
description: Step on each beat of the paired swings so the two heads never cross or foul.

name: Sanguine Looping
description: Pass the chain from one hand to the other so each head follows the line of the last.

name: Tearing Headball
description: Copy the lead head's swing in the off hand so the two heads fall as mirror images.

name: Handstaff Remedy
description: Feel both chains at once so both heads and the opponent between them stay in mind.

name: Tearing Thresh
description: Cross the two heads before the chest then pull them apart into the opponent's open sides.

name: Torrent Flailhead
description: Bend one head around a thrust like a river bend and send the other back along its path.

name: Unyielding Hingecap
description: Sweep both heads in overlapping arcs to make a moving shield in front of the body.

name: Blazeswivel
description: Lift both heads high then bring them down together on one point like two hawks stooping.

name: Ponderous Spikehead
description: Weave the two chains into an overlapping net round the opponent's weapon arm and tighten both together.

name: Might Wheel
description: Rise on the toes with the head overhead then drop the whole body into the stoop of the swing.

name: Swingarm Elixir
description: Keep the qi field open overhead to sense a falling attack before it breaks from above.

name: Unflinching Swivel
description: Spread the arms like wings with the haft across the head and the chain across the back.

name: Might Hingecap
description: Drop from a high step into a low lunge that carries the head down with the body.

name: Gust Chainring
description: Hold still at the top of the swing like a hawk on a perch and strike on the opponent's first move.

name: Iron Chainlink
description: Flick the head up from below so it climbs into the chin before the opponent's guard rises.

name: Sanguine Headball
description: Let the head fall and snap it back by the chain so the same stoop repeats at once.

name: Flailhead Greave
description: Spin the head overhead as a roof that bats down arrows and thrown knives.

name: Flailthrash
description: Drop the head from its highest arc with qi packed in it so it lands as one crushing blow.

name: Granite Linkband
description: Strike left and right in two quick dives with the head flying in a wide shallow V.

name: Might Looping
description: Step across a stream or ditch with the head swinging level so the crossing leaves no opening.

name: Rupturing Swingthru
description: Swing left then right in one even beat so each side is struck in turn.

name: Gustthresh
description: Keep the weight uphill on a slanted bank and let the swing run downhill into the foe.

name: Handstaff Onslaught
description: Let the head drift along the line of flow like a current then jerk it into the opponent.

name: Resilient Spikehead
description: Turn the haft in a small eddy that carries a blow around and past the shoulder.

name: Iron Chainring
description: Skip the head low off the ground twice before it rises into the thigh.

name: Unmaking Swingarm
description: Send down two falls of the head one after the other like a waterfall in steps.

name: Thornflail
description: Spin the head in a tightening spiral around the opponent's weapon to draw it into the whirl.

name: Aegisflail
description: Plant the haft like a weir stake so a rush splits and flows past on either side.

name: Lancing Lashout
description: Fork one swing into two arcs by switching hands at the last beat so the head lands on either flank.

name: Lambasting Silt Swivel
description: Release both heads at the crest of a swing to flood the whole front with iron.

name: Needling Hingecap
description: Hide the head behind the body on the bend of a spin then cut out of the blind side.

name: Rumble Wheel
description: Swing with the wind at the back so the head rides the gust and lands with its weight behind the blow.

name: Charter Headball
description: Hold a firm stance on open ground with the haft turned into the wind and nothing covering the back.

name: Mightthresh
description: Step off the line of the wind so the head swings across it rather than against it.

name: Restoring Linkband
description: Feel gusts tug the chain and use them to judge the opponent's distance and angle.

name: Blazeflail
description: Curve a swing in a crosswind so the head bends around the guard and lands from the side.

name: Chime Headball
description: Hold the chain taut across the body as an oath is held and turn a thrust away along it.

name: Sanguine Thresh
description: Sweep the head along the plateau's edge so a foe backing toward the drop must stop or fall.

name: Blaze Chainlink
description: Time the head's fall to a gust and let the wind add its weight to the qi in the blow.

name: Mightswivel
description: Hold the head in an orbit set on one bearing so it strikes along that line whatever the wind does.

name: Granite Swingthru
description: Cast the head far out across open ground in a flat throw from the shoulder.

name: Granite Thresh
description: Fix the opponent's bearing and step so that it stays the same however he moves.

name: Blaze Swingarm
description: Reel the chain in with the wind at the back so the head returns faster than it left.

name: Thorngimbal
description: Take the stance of the sworn guard with chin high haft low and the chain trailing as a line.

name: Chime Flailhead
description: Rest the eyes on the horizon and feel the opponent's motion at the edge of sight.

name: Tempered Lashout
description: Strike upward from a crouch so the head meets a foe who has leapt over the low guard.

name: Hamstringing Hingecap
description: Draw the chain across an opponent's legs on open ground and pull so he drifts toward the edge.

name: Hardened Chainlink
description: Meet a rush on one fixed bearing and let the chain turn it aside without giving ground.

name: Chainring Maelstrom
description: Whirl the head in a wide circle with nothing at the back so every side is struck.

name: Flailtorment
description: Swear the swing to one line and drop the head along it with the whole weight of the body.

name: Needling Linkband
description: Start from the toe and let the swing grow through hip shoulder and wrist into a wide head arc.

name: Charter Swivel
description: Spread the feet on hard plateau ground and bend the knees to take the swing's recoil.

name: Soaring Spikehead
description: Time the footfall to the wind's pulse so the body lands as the gust peaks.

name: Gimbalremedy
description: Listen to the chain's hum in flight to know how fast the head travels and where it is.

name: Rumbleflail
description: Sweep the head out in the widest flat arc to clear everything at its own height.

name: Flailplating
description: Reel the head into guard as a squall of blows arrives so it covers the body.

name: Swivelthrash
description: Pay out the whole chain and turn in place so the head spins out in a hissing ring.

name: Equipoise Swivel
description: Turn the haft windward and let the wind press a deflected blow further off line.

name: Rumble Handstaff
description: Drive the head along the ridge line of an opponent's guard to find the gap between hand and shoulder.

name: Looping Assault
description: Gather the swing's length for a single cut at the far end of the reach with the wind carrying it.

name: Dismantling Wheel
description: Spin the head in the wind until blows come from every direction out of a ring of whistling iron.

name: Lancing Looping
description: Let the long swing run its full arc and release every stored turn of the body at once.
